Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result

Class ActionResultBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result.ActionResultBuilder
public class ActionResultBuilder extends Object
Builder for creating ActionResult instances with the new component architecture. Provides a fluent API for constructing complex action results.

This builder bridges the gap between the new component-based architecture and the existing ActionResult API, enabling gradual migration.

Since:
2.0
